description: How much is usually done by this time of the logical day. A done mark (task done_on or routine check 'done') comes with `at`, the local moment it was written (from its HLC clock). It counts only when `at` falls on its own logical day `date`; a mark written on another day (an import, a past day checked later) has no usable time and is ignored. Its offset is the minutes from the start of that logical day (day_start_hour). Window: the 28 days before today, but not before the first day with a counted mark; days in it with nothing count as 0. usual = marks in the window with offset <= now's offset, divided by the number of days, rounded to 1 decimal. Fewer than 3 days: usual null.

cases.name: only marks up to now's offset count, quiet days in the window are zeros
after midnight the night belongs to the day before, and late marks of past days count
marks written on another day are ignored, so imported history does not start the window
the window is the last 28 days
